snippet.title: Smiley Arena — Launch Trailer | Lane Tower Defense
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053510/Smiley_Arena/

A lane-based tower defense where you don’t just place towers — you fight alongside them. Pick one of six classes, hold 40 waves, and get past the Veteran at the end. Then keep going in endless mode.

Six playable classes, each with its own ability: Fire, Ice, Shadow, Medic, Bomb, Speed
A boss every fifth wave — the King, the Bandit, the Madman, and the Veteran at wave 40
Build turrets during a freeze pause and upgrade them three times, up to the Elite turret
Level-ups with upgrade choices, achievements, checkpoints at waves 11, 21 and 31
Three biomes, six music tracks, English and German
